function.name: bash
function.description: Run commands in a bash shell. State is persistent across calls.

command.description: The bash command to run. Relative path is preferred in the command.

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend.

old_string.description: Literal text to replace. Must match exactly.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The wider sandbox mode this file operation needs. Only valid as a one-shot retry of an operation the sandbox just denied; requires justification and user approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access.

function.name: read
function.description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

function.name: read_image
function.description: Read a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF file and return the image itself. A path without a file extension is accepted; the format is detected from the file content, so normalized attachment paths can be passed directly without copying or renaming. Harness validates and downscales large supported images before the next model request, so use this tool directly instead of installing image libraries or creating thumbnails merely to inspect an image. Independent files may be read concurrently in small batches. Requires the current model to accept image input.

file_path.description: Path to the image file, resolved by the filesystem backend.

function.name: team_collect
function.description: Read the durable state of admitted work units by their request tokens (the async work-status read-back): each token reports running (the async continuation is still in flight, or the chain crashed before settlement — a same-token re-delegate RESUMES the unit instead of admitting a second one) or the terminal member result (succeeded / failed / unavailable, served verbatim from the durable settlement fact). Read-only: it writes nothing and delivers nothing.

rootSessionId.description: The TeamSession (root session) id this operation belongs to.

requestToken.description: A token unique to THIS logical operation (non-empty, max 128 chars). Reuse the exact same token only when retrying the same logical operation; never reuse it for a different one.

requestTokens.description: The work request tokens to read: the requestToken each team_delegate / team_follow_up call was given (1..64 non-empty strings, max 128 chars each).

function.name: team_create_member
function.description: Create a NEW member instance from a blueprint template (explicit creation; the activation authority enforces quota, envelope, and gates).

rootSessionId.description: The TeamSession (root session) id this operation belongs to.

requestToken.description: A token unique to THIS logical operation (non-empty, max 128 chars). Reuse the exact same token only when retrying the same logical operation; never reuse it for a different one.

delegationTemplateId.description: The blueprint template id the new member is created from.

label.description: A short human-readable label for the new member instance (non-empty).

groupId.description: Optional group id for the new member.

workspace.description: Optional workspace path override for the new member.

function.name: team_delegate
function.description: Delegate work: either create a NEW member from a template and admit the work on it, or admit new work on an EXISTING member instance. Provide exactly one of delegationTemplateId / delegationInstanceId. Synchronous by default: the call returns when the work unit has settled (the member result is in the response). Pass async: true to admit the work durably and return immediately (the response carries the admission receipt — workStatus "admitted", settled false, no result); read the terminal result back with team_collect (the same request token).

rootSessionId.description: The TeamSession (root session) id this operation belongs to.

requestToken.description: A token unique to THIS logical operation (non-empty, max 128 chars). Reuse the exact same token only when retrying the same logical operation; never reuse it for a different one.

delegationTemplateId.description: Present: create a new member from this template and delegate to it.

delegationInstanceId.description: Present: delegate new work to this existing member instance (its persistent context is kept).

label.description: A short human-readable label for the new member instance (non-empty).

groupId.description: Optional group id for a new member.

workspace.description: Optional workspace path override for a new member.

taskSummary.description: Optional short summary of the delegated work unit (audit context).

prompt.description: REQUIRED: the exact work prompt delivered (model-visible) to the member's bound child session. No default inheritance from the caller or sibling transcripts.

attachedContext.description: Optional explicit context attached to the work unit and delivered with the prompt.

async.description: Optional (default false): run the work unit ASYNCHRONOUSLY — the call returns as soon as the durable admission is committed (the response effect carries workStatus "admitted", settled false, and NO member result); the terminal result is then read back with team_collect. Omit or false for the default synchronous behavior (the call blocks until the work unit settles and the response carries the member result).

function.name: team_follow_up
function.description: Admit a follow-up work unit on an EXISTING member instance (persistent delegation: the same bound child session is kept). Synchronous by default: the call returns when the work unit has settled (the member result is in the response). Pass async: true to admit the work durably and return immediately (the response carries the admission receipt — workStatus "admitted", settled false, no result); read the terminal result back with team_collect (the same request token).

rootSessionId.description: The TeamSession (root session) id this operation belongs to.

requestToken.description: A token unique to THIS logical operation (non-empty, max 128 chars). Reuse the exact same token only when retrying the same logical operation; never reuse it for a different one.

targetInstanceId.description: The member INSTANCE id the operation is addressed to (labels and template ids are rejected).

taskSummary.description: Optional short summary of the follow-up work unit (audit context).

prompt.description: REQUIRED: the exact follow-up work prompt delivered (model-visible) to the member's bound child session. No default inheritance from the caller or sibling transcripts.

attachedContext.description: Optional explicit context attached to the work unit and delivered with the prompt.

async.description: Optional (default false): run the work unit ASYNCHRONOUSLY — the call returns as soon as the durable admission is committed (the response effect carries workStatus "admitted", settled false, and NO member result); the terminal result is then read back with team_collect. Omit or false for the default synchronous behavior (the call blocks until the work unit settles and the response carries the member result).

function.name: team_inspect_config
function.description: Inspect the effective policy configuration of ONE member instance. `effective` = the legacy GENERIC capability policy view (the per-capability values after overlay and external facts; its `permissions` cell is a legacy generic cell and NOT the alpha.2 operation-permission authority). `operationPermissions` = the ACTUAL static parameter-aware operation-permission policy enforced by alpha.2 for this instance (the bound template capabilities.permissions: default plus allow/ask/deny rules as stored, plus the managedTools and resourceKinds vocabulary; `mode: "absent"` when the template declares no permissions).

rootSessionId.description: The TeamSession (root session) id this operation belongs to.

requestToken.description: A token unique to THIS logical operation (non-empty, max 128 chars). Reuse the exact same token only when retrying the same logical operation; never reuse it for a different one.

targetInstanceId.description: The member INSTANCE id the operation is addressed to (labels and template ids are rejected).

function.name: team_list_members
function.description: List every member instance of the team with its template id, label, lifecycle state, and bound child session id.

rootSessionId.description: The TeamSession (root session) id this operation belongs to.

requestToken.description: A token unique to THIS logical operation (non-empty, max 128 chars). Reuse the exact same token only when retrying the same logical operation; never reuse it for a different one.

function.name: team_list_templates
function.description: List the member templates of the team's bound blueprint (template id, display name, context policy).

rootSessionId.description: The TeamSession (root session) id this operation belongs to.

requestToken.description: A token unique to THIS logical operation (non-empty, max 128 chars). Reuse the exact same token only when retrying the same logical operation; never reuse it for a different one.

function.name: team_report_progress
function.description: Report progress on one work subject of a member instance (in-progress | completed | blocked; the per-subject sequence is derived from the durable ledger, with one bounded retry on a stale sequence).

rootSessionId.description: The TeamSession (root session) id this operation belongs to.

requestToken.description: A token unique to THIS logical operation (non-empty, max 128 chars). Reuse the exact same token only when retrying the same logical operation; never reuse it for a different one.

instanceId.description: The member INSTANCE id the operation is addressed to (labels and template ids are rejected).

subject.description: The telemetry subject (the work lane within the instance; max 256 chars).

progress.description: The closed status: in-progress | completed | blocked.

function.name: team_request_control
function.description: Request approval for one operation scope (kind: leader-approval | user-approval | envelope-mutation). The operation stays blocked until a resolver (leader/human per kind — never a member) records a decision. Idempotent over the scope identity: retrying with the same token returns the existing request.

rootSessionId.description: The TeamSession (root session) id this operation belongs to.

requestToken.description: A token unique to THIS logical operation (non-empty, max 128 chars). Reuse the exact same token only when retrying the same logical operation; never reuse it for a different one.

kind.description: The request kind: leader-approval | user-approval | envelope-mutation.

targetInstanceId.description: The member INSTANCE id the operation is addressed to (labels and template ids are rejected).

actionName.description: The logical operation name the approval gates (max 128 chars).

toolName.description: Optional: the tool name the operation runs through (max 128 chars).

summary.description: Optional one-line summary for the resolver (max 512 chars).

function.name: team_resolve_control
function.description: Record an allow/deny decision on a pending control request (resolver roles per kind: leader-approval -> leader|human, user-approval -> human only, envelope-mutation -> leader|human; a member is never a resolver). An allow authorizes the exact scope exactly once, consumed by the last-mile guard.

rootSessionId.description: The TeamSession (root session) id this operation belongs to.

requestToken.description: A token unique to THIS logical operation (non-empty, max 128 chars). Reuse the exact same token only when retrying the same logical operation; never reuse it for a different one.

requestId.description: The durable control request id to decide (max 128 chars).

function.name: team_send_message
function.description: Send one message to a member instance (instance-addressed; the relay policy mediates through the leader where required). The recipient receives ordinary attributed input on its bound session.

rootSessionId.description: The TeamSession (root session) id this operation belongs to.

requestToken.description: A token unique to THIS logical operation (non-empty, max 128 chars). Reuse the exact same token only when retrying the same logical operation; never reuse it for a different one.

recipientInstanceId.description: The member INSTANCE id the operation is addressed to (labels and template ids are rejected).

body.description: The message body (non-empty, max 8192 chars; stored verbatim).

function.name: write
function.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

sandbox_permissions.description: The wider sandbox mode this file operation needs. Only valid as a one-shot retry of an operation the sandbox just denied; requires justification and user approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access.
